purpose: Teach: 伊丹/長岡/武藤/菊池/亀田/五十嵐/塚本/八田

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、伊丹刑事の現場対応も評価されますね
lines.en: Detective Itami's on-scene work is being recognized, isn't it.
lines.style: Conversational, respectful. Measured cadence, acknowledging competence without flattery. Slight upward lilt at the end—genuine question, not statement.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、参考人長岡氏から、警察、事情を伺われますね
lines.en: The police are gathering a careful statement from Nagaoka, the witness.
lines.style: Same rhythm as the previous line. Professional tone, matter-of-fact. Slight emphasis on thoroughness without rushing. Level eye contact implied.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、被害者武藤氏のご家族にも、警察、配慮されますね
lines.en: They're being considerate toward the victim's family, Mutoh's family.
lines.style: Warm undertone beneath the formal phrasing. Slower on the middle clause—acknowledging the human weight. Respectful pause before naming.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、目撃者菊池氏の供述を、警察、整えられますね
lines.en: Witness Kikuchi's statement is being carefully documented.
lines.style: Back to steady, administrative tone. Crisp and precise. No rush. The tone of someone who knows procedure matters in moments like this.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、容疑者亀田の前科を、警察、確認されますね
lines.en: They're confirming the suspect Kameda's prior record.
lines.style: Slight shift—more official, less warmth. Direct, businesslike. The tone hardens minimally but noticeably on 'prior record.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、署内の鑑識五十嵐主任と現場検証されますね
lines.en: Working with forensic expert Igarashi from the station for the scene investigation.
lines.style: Efficient, collaborative. Respect in the naming. Steady pace, no hesitation. Tone suggests this is necessary, coordinated work.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、心理士塚本様にご助言を仰がれますね
lines.en: They're consulting with psychologist Tsukamoto for guidance.
lines.style: Slightly softer return. Acknowledgment of expertise sought. Respectful of the specialty. Slower on 'psychologist'—recognizing the care that requires.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 警察、検事の八田様と公判前協議もされますね
lines.en: And with prosecutor Hatta on preliminary conference discussions as well.
lines.style: Closer, more intimate. The tone shifts to something more personal—less procedural, more conspiratorial. Slight lean inward implied. Quieter on 'conference,' like sharing something understood between them.
